earnings.title: KINDER MORGAN REPORTS RECORD THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS
highlights: Earnings per share (EPS) and Adjusted EPS both 21% higher than 2025
Third quarter net income attributable to KMI of $764 million.
Adjusted Net Income Attributable to KMI, which excludes Certain Items, was $792 million, 22% higher than the third quarter of 2025.
Announces $5.4 Billion of Additions to Expansion Project Backlog

HOUSTON, October 21, 2026 - Kinder Morgan, Inc.’s (NYSE: KMI) board of directors today approved a cash dividend of $0.2975 per share for the third quarter ($1.19 annualized), payable on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 2, 2026.

quotes.text: Our natural gas business in particular is benefiting from increasing LNG exports, rising power demand, and industrial expansion and is capitalizing on significant opportunities for investment across our footprint.
